description: Fetch metadata for one country or aggregate: ISO codes, region, income level, lending type, capital, and coordinates. Browse codes with worldbank_list_countries.

country_code.description: One ISO2 (US), ISO3 (USA), or World Bank aggregate (EAS, HIC, WLD) code; not "all" or a list.

name: worldbank_get_country

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `country_not_found`: No country or aggregate has this code. `multiple_countries`: The code selects more than one country, as "all" does. `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

isAggregate.description: True for a regional or income-group aggregate, whose capitalCity, longitude, and latitude are empty.

title: Get World Bank Country
